offerings.name: Search
offerings.pricing: Search: 2 credits / 10 results. Credits are shared across all endpoints; paid plans offer pay-as-you-go credits in $5 increments.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits / month; 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped
offerings.output_type: 结构化 web、news、images 搜索结果；可选返回每个结果的完整页面 markdown、HTML、links 或 screenshots
offerings.note: 搜索结果默认包含 query-relevant Highlights；1–10 结果收费 2 credits，按每 10 个结果向上取整。

offerings.name: End-to-End ZDR
offerings.output_type: Zero Data Retention 搜索结果；可结合 scrapeOptions 返回结果页面内容
offerings.note: 仅 Enterprise plans；Firecrawl 与上游搜索提供商均执行零数据保留。

offerings.name: Anonymized ZDR
offerings.output_type: Zero Data Retention 搜索结果；可结合 scrapeOptions 返回结果页面内容
offerings.note: 仅 Enterprise plans；搜索提供商可能缓存查询，但查询不附带身份信息。
